mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rating_history (user_id, match_id, tournament_id, rating_before, rating_after, delta, opponent_id, opponent_rating, result, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{matchId}, #{tournamentId}, #{ratingBefore}, #{ratingAfter}, #{delta}, #{opponentId}, #{opponentRating}, #{result}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rating_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND match_id = #{matchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rating_history WHERE match_id = #{matchId}
